newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela inflation goal maximum 35 pct - Petkoff.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela inflation goal maximum 35 pct - Petkoff.

text.p: The Venezuelan government plans to keep tight control on spending to ensure that inflation does not exceed 35 percent this year, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said Thursday.
"The government is going to keep very rigorous control over public spending so that the inflation goal does not exceed between 30 and 35 percent," Petkoff told reporters in Congress.
Petkoff acknowledged that the government's original inflation target of 25 percent for 1997 had been disrupted by a recent 75 percent pay rise settlement with public sector workers.
The decision to raise wages above the expected inflation level would help workers recover lost spending power eroded by years of high inflation, he said.
